definitions: To happen in a particular way, or to have a particular result, especially an unexpected one.
To be discovered or found to be.
To force someone to leave a place.
To empty the contents of something.
examples: The party turned out to be a huge success.
It turns out that she was right all along.
The factory turns out hundreds of cars every day.
They turned him out of the house for not paying rent.
Please turn out the lights when you leave.
She turned out her pockets looking for the keys.
